description: You are the newly appointed Security Manager at a commercial property management company. A compliance audit has flagged that the VMS is failing to maintain continuous 24/7 surveillance — some cameras are missing valid recording schedules, creating liability gaps. Log in to the Nx Witness Web Admin at https://localhost:7001/static/index.html (credentials: admin / Admin1234!). Audit the recording configuration of every camera in the system, identify the cameras with broken or disabled recording schedules, and remediate the gaps by enabling 24/7 continuous high-quality recording on each affected camera. All cameras must record continuously around the clock, covering all seven days of the week. Once every camera in the system has confirmed continuous recording, create a shared monitoring layout named 'Compliance Audit View' containing all cameras so the compliance officer can perform a visual walkthrough.
